control_capture_limit: Concrete poisoned outcomes captured by the actual run are retained with each detected flag; the mutation recipes are pinned by the tested fixture source. No new scientific or comparator execution was performed by this assembler.
scope_limits: Selected component cases on the exact development f1 macOS Seatbelt tuple.
Expected-error cases are recorded with exact type and message; raw execute-error envelopes are withheld because their frames name private paths.
No frontend, original package registration, live Pack Manager, registry or current production-profile adoption.
The returned terminal status is retained as data; the actual result and recorded retirement were independently accepted for this scoped record only.

One actual attempt with zero automatic retries; no scientific body was rerun for publication. Interim PARTIAL.json status labels are write-ahead snapshots of that same attempt, superseded by the terminal component and packaging records.

Unchanged owner bounds: 120 s whole (initial pre-CONFIG 150 s), 90 s work, 15 s cleanup, 140 s passive witness with a launch gap of at most 20 s, 2 GiB sampled aggregate RSS, 512 KiB streams and worker JSON, 16 MiB child-file limit, at most 150 concurrently owned observed processes, one Guest. They are sampled limits, not hard memory or CPU quotas.

Observed-lineage and POSIX identity sampling is not an exhaustive transient-child census or an atomic kernel lifetime proof; the pre-fsync uncatchable-kill gap remains open. Non-socket directories remained in the private temporary root; complete deletion is not claimed.
Initial and supplemental post-caller independent retirement checks both found all recorded processes and groups and the RPC socket and its directory absent in two snapshots each.
The private operator stderr retains an environment warning: a pynvml deprecation notice. It did not fail the run and is not a pack defect.

Guest_evidence.policy: deny-default Seatbelt profile; text withheld because it names private local paths

error_diagnostics.error_PID_limit: Observed same session only; cached last_guest_pid on errors is not a fresh error-reply PID receipt
